title: Cast Iron vs. PVC in Modern Drainage Systems
description: Selecting the right pipe material for drainage systems directly impacts acoustic performance, structural fire protection, and system longevity. Schedule 40 PVC is lightweight, highly resistant to chemical corrosion, and cost-effective, making it the industry standard for residential DWV applications. However, cast iron soil pipe remains invaluable in multi-family and commercial installations due to its exceptional sound-dampening qualities and fire rating. The heavy mass of cast iron dramatically reduces fluid flow noise inside wall cavities. Understanding these material characteristics helps plumbers select the right system based on acoustic needs, building codes, and job specifications.
